title: Hattiesburg Eye Clinic
description: hattiesburgeyeclinic.com zoominfo.com/c/hattiesburg-eye-clinic-pa/46138946 1974-founded family ophthalmology practice in Hattiesburg, Mississippi — started by Dr. David Richardson and now run by his son Dr. Ben Richardson, making it the region's oldest and largest eye clinic (8 ophthalmologists + 1 optometrist, on-site surgery center and optical shop). Full-stack eye care under one roof: cataract surgery — including the first Light Adjustable Lens (RxSight LAL) in south Mississippi — LASIK, glaucoma (MIGS), retina injections, oculoplastics, pediatric and diabetic eye care.
